items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So earlier you said you went back at 19 to finish up high school. So you actually didn’t take Papa Joe’s advice, you didn’t finish high school.

ctx.x: Yeah. Strangely enough man, I had no idea Red was as young as he was, but Red was already a name, you know. He was working with everybody, all the places. But I guess from 16 on, that’s when I was making my living playing. That’s all I was doing.
So earlier you said you went back at 19 to finish up high school. So you actually didn’t take Papa Joe’s advice, you didn’t finish high school.
